One of the best Vegetarian restaurants I have ever been.
Jun 2025 • Family
Cồ Đàm Chay is a true gem for anyone who appreciates exquisite vegetarian cuisine and striking design. The building blends Champa architecture with serene Buddhist details, creating an atmosphere that feels like both a gallery and a sanctuary. Each dish arrives as a small work of art, beautifully presented, vibrant in color, and rich in flavor that satisfies even those who usually prefer meat. From the first bite to the last glance around the dining room, the experience is thoughtful, balanced, and memorable. Highly recommended for every diner.

A Truly Special Vegetarian Spot in Hanoi
Jun 2025 • Couples
This place completely blew us away. From the moment we walked in, everything felt calm, elegant, and beautifully designed, from the decor to the overall atmosphere.

My partner and I genuinely enjoyed every single dish. Each one was like a little piece of art, stunning to look at and even better to taste. It’s amazing how much creativity and flavor they bring to vegetarian cuisine.

The service was wonderful too, warm, attentive, and made us feel so well taken care of.

It’s truly memorable, this spot is an absolute must visit.

Best Vegetarian Meal in My Life, Maybe Best Meal
Jan 2025 • Family
I was with my family headed to another restaurant when we walked by and was literally stopped in our tracks by how beautiful a restaurant this appeared to be. We saw that this was Michelin selected, and changed our plans immediately. We ended up getting the only table available without reservations and wow.

There were 4 of us, and one of us had significant dietary restrictions, and the staff worked with the restrictions so professionally! We were able to order 2 of each of the set menu options to try everything. And let me say, I'm not one to Instagram my meals, but I took pictures of each dish. They were presented in such a creative and aesthetically pleasing way, and the food was amazing. I found myself excited for the each next dish, even though my stomach was telling me I was full. The whole dinner was an experience, not just a meal, and one I won't soon forget. 

I went on to travel in Vietnam another 3 weeks and have been back home now for a week, and I'm still thinking about how good this restaurant is.

Weird vibe
Nov 2024 • Couples
Something is really off about this place. It is supposed to be one of the top restaurants, but was 3/4 empty when we visited. Five star reviews on Ttip Advisor but only 11 reviews total. The tasting menus are illegibly scrawled on a paper fan, totally unreadable. $40/person is expensive for Hanoi, could be worth it if the food is truly amazing. But there is no wine sold by the glass, and the least expensive bottle is $80. The building is beautiful but has a heavily staged vibe. We got a bad feeling and left. Check out the much more mixed reviews on Google Maps.

Ultra high-end Vegetarian fine dining
Jan 2023 • Couples
Went there for dinner with my husband. They have 2 different types of 11-course set meal. Each set cost about USD40++ excluding drinks. We spent about USD95 (including tax) for 2 set meals + non alcoholic drinks.

The waiter/waitress will do an intro with each dish served. It is fine-dining, so read “really small portion”. Food is fresh & good. Not a place you will come every night for dinner, but definitely worth a try.
